    • 字段详细资料

      • backupEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="BackupEnabled")
public String backupEnabled

        Indicates whether the overall cross-region backup feature is enabled. Valid values:

        • Disable: The feature is disabled.
        • Enable: The feature is enabled.
        example:

        Enable

      • crossBackupRegion

        @NameInMap(value="CrossBackupRegion")
public String crossBackupRegion

        The ID of the destination region for cross-region backup.

        example:

        cn-shanghai

      • crossBackupType

        @NameInMap(value="CrossBackupType")
public String crossBackupType

        The retention type of cross-region backups. Default value: 1, which indicates that all backups are retained.

        example:

        1

      • DBInstanceId

        @NameInMap(value="DBInstanceId")
public String DBInstanceId

        The instance ID.

        example:

        rm-uf6wjk5****

      • logBackupEnabled

        @NameInMap(value="LogBackupEnabled")
public String logBackupEnabled

        Indicates whether cross-region log backup is enabled. Valid values:

        • Disable: Cross-region log backup is disabled.
        • Enable: Cross-region log backup is enabled.
        example:

        Enable

      • regionId

        @NameInMap(value="RegionId")
public String regionId

        The region ID of the source instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs.

        example:

        cn-hangzhou

      • requestId

        @NameInMap(value="RequestId")
public String requestId

        The request ID.

        example:

        50A6059D-6DBB-46C6-A851-1EE93C9013CF

      • retentType

        @NameInMap(value="RetentType")
public Integer retentType

        The retention method for cross-region backups. Default value: 1, which indicates that backups are retained based on a specified retention period.

        example:

        1

      • retention

        @NameInMap(value="Retention")
public Integer retention

        The retention period of cross-region backups. Valid values: 7 to 1825. Unit: days.

        example:

        15
